image_description: Two small Blenheim spaniel puppies lying close together on a textured, multi-colored blanket. The puppy on the left is curled with its head down, showing the top of its head and ears. The puppy on the right is facing forward/sideways, showing one large dark eye, long feathered ear, and red-and-white coat pattern.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The puppy on the right clearly displays a domed skull shape typical of the breed. The puppy on the left shows the dome from above. The stop appears well-defined though partially obscured by angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye of the right puppy is large, round, and dark. The spacing appears consistent with the 'wide apart' description given the broad forehead.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both puppies exhibit long, low-set ears with significant feathering/fringe visible, matching the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat pattern is distinctly parti-color with rich chestnut/red patches against a white background. The boundaries between colors are relatively clear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears soft and slightly wavy/silky rather than coarse. Feathering is evident on the ears and visible leg portions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible body mass of the puppies suggests a compact, cobby build typical of toy spaniels, though full body length is partially obscured by posture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible front paws/legs appear to have fine bone structure. Feathering is visible on the rear/leg areas that are in view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tails are not clearly visible in this specific crop/posture; they are either occluded by the bodies or outside the immediate focus area.
The subjects are stationary/lying down, making gait assessment impossible.
